c: In the CMDB Workspace, My work lists your tasks and Intelligent search finds a CI.
say: Open the CMDB workspace. My work lists the tasks waiting for you, and intelligent search finds a CI by name.

c: Keep the Support group, Change Group, Owned by and statuses right on each CI you own.
say: On each CI you own, keep the support group, the change group, the owner, and its statuses right.

c: Certification audits check CI data on a schedule, assigned to the CI's Managed by.
say: Certification audits check CI data on a schedule, such as critical business services every week, assigned to whoever manages the CI.

c: You're emailed when asked to attest, and can fix the CIs you own.
say: You're emailed when you are asked to attest, and you can edit the CIs you own to fix what the audit finds.
